PP.unmeasured: short rings or a landing missing

WW.unmeasured: no source within 10 tiles, or no sip
WW.falsifier: a sip with no liquid rise

OF.each arrived read: levels.overfull = view.classes.overfull = probe level = fullnessLevel(mirror stomachMass); route own
OF.falsifier: a disagreement at an arrived read
OF.unmeasured: a threshold never passed (named), or no arrival

deviations: The phases are the run sheet's S4a list plus the amendments' Body fat read; C, D, E, F, G and I are absorbed or dropped (run sheet (b)).
B1 runs at true multiplier 0.1, restored after: the server answers the bus every 20 ticks or at a minute event, so at 0.625 s a game minute every pair of reads would straddle a write.
Ruling 3's read-back is the setpath's own `before`, at every poll, not a lua.global once a game minute.
The 0.2 s poll is POLL_S between commands; a poll is two to four server commands (one to four game minutes).
The protein pair is a live reading off two rings; the replay arm is left to a regrade or dropped.
The Body fat read is a lua.read of NutritionRevamp.client (the rows are a table lua.call cannot return).
